title: Business Central AL Customization Project
desc:
My priority is to build and refine Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central through new AL objects, with the spotlight on custom tables and pages. These pages must support clean data entry, run their own validation, trigger custom workflows, and surface key metrics in dashboard-style reports.  

Beyond the UI layer, I need business logic that enforces bespoke validation rules and handles data integration processes so information moves reliably between internal modules and any external systems we connect later.  

Additional work will include, when required, adjusting RDLC or Word layouts for reports, extending posting and approval workflows, exposing data through APIs or web services, and tuning SQL for performance.  

Deliverables  
• AL code for tables, pages, and supporting codeunits  
• Implemented validation rules and workflow logic, fully tested  
• Dashboard/report layouts and any modified RDLC/Word files  
• Technical documentation (object list, install steps, test scripts)  
• Source packaged in a Git repository and a compiled extension ready for deployment  

Acceptance Criteria  
• Extension installs without compile warnings or permission errors  
• All test scenarios for data entry, validation, and workflow pass  
• Performance meets current production benchmarks  
• Documentation is clear enough for another developer to maintain  

I will provide functional specs and a sandbox; you return weekly progress updates and commit to the agreed timeline and quality gates.

title: AI Cattle Collar Development
desc:
I need a working prototype of an AI-enabled collar that keeps real-time watch over a cow’s well-being and daily habits. The collar has to:

• Track health by continuously capturing heart rate, temperature and respiration, flagging anomalies for early intervention.  
• Record activity patterns—grazing time, walking distance and rest periods—so I can optimise feed plans and pasture rotation.

I am open to your recommended sensor suite, low-power electronics, edge AI models and a simple companion app or dashboard that turns raw readings into clear, actionable insights. Deliver a fully assembled collar with firmware, data pipeline and a short demo showing the metrics streaming accurately from a live test or simulator.  

If you have previous experience in livestock wearables, embedded ML (TensorFlow Lite, Edge Impulse or similar) and rugged hardware design, I’d like to see it and discuss the timeline to first field trials.

title: Organic Makhana Seasoning Blend
desc:
I need a reliable partner to develop and scale an herbs-and-spices seasoning specifically for makhana snack flavoring. The blend must rely solely on natural, organic ingredients—no synthetics, artificial colors, or anti-caking agents. I already have a taste direction in mind (lightly earthy with a gentle kick), but I am open to your suggestions for achieving a standout profile that will keep consumers reaching for the next handful.

What I expect from you:
• A finished formulation with exact percentages and processing instructions  
• Guidance on sourcing certified-organic raw materials and possible alternate suppliers for cost control  
• A small pilot batch (1–2 kg) for sensory and shelf-life testing  
• Documentation on regulatory compliance and nutritional data suitable for export packaging  
• Clear scale-up notes so the recipe can move straight into commercial production

Experience with snack-food seasonings, spice milling, and organic certification will be valued highly. If you can demonstrate previous results with clean-label products or have access to extrusion/coating equipment for test runs, please mention it in your proposal along with an estimated timeline to first samples.

title: Grow Telegram via Instagram Ads
desc:
I run a Telegram channel for traders and want to fill it with genuinely interested subscribers—not bots or vague “finance” traffic, but people who actively follow trading content. To do this I need a specialist who can plan, launch, and optimise Instagram Explore ads.

You’ll handle the full campaign inside Meta Ads Manager: research the most responsive trading-focused interests, craft creative that speaks to that niche, set up a clear funnel straight to my Telegram link, and keep a close eye on performance so spend translates into quality joins. Story or Feed placements can remain off for now; the push is squarely on Explore where discovery is highest for new audiences.

Please ensure all conversions are real humans. I’ll monitor engagement stats on the channel and will pause the project immediately if artificial traffic appears.

Deliverables:
• Live Explore-placement campaign targeting trading enthusiasts  
• Compelling image or short-form video ads plus copy  
• Daily optimisation and budget pacing  
• Weekly report summarising spend, CPM, CTR, cost-per-join, and overall subscriber growth

Share a quick outline of your approach, any similar Telegram growth results, and the timeframe you expect before the first noticeable bump in subscribers. Let’s drive serious traders into the channel together.

title: Nifty50 Minute OHLC Data -- 2
desc:
I need a clean, gap-free OHLC data set for the Nifty 50 index on a 1-minute timeframe covering 1 January 2020 right up to the end of the current trading day. I will supply an Excel template that already lists every required timestamp; simply populate the Open, High, Low and Close columns against each row.

Key points  
• Source must be Zerodha only (Kite historical API or another Zerodha-backed feed).  
• No extra fields are necessary—just the four price columns.  
• Final delivery should be the same workbook returned to me in .xlsx format, ready for immediate use.

Before we wrap up, I’ll verify the file for missing intervals, incorrect time zones (IST), or obvious outliers. Once everything checks out, the job is complete.

title: Contabilidad QuickBooks Online Intermedio
desc:
Busco apoyo continuo para llevar la contabilidad diaria de algunas compañias e EEUU en QuickBooks Online. Necesito a alguien con nivel intermedio comprobable que pueda trabajar de forma autónoma, manteniendo una comunicación clara en español y con capacidad de leer y escribir en inglés cuando sea necesario.

Las responsabilidades principales serán:
• Registrar y conciliar todas las transacciones bancarias de manera oportuna.  
• Revisar y depurar los estados financieros antes de su presentación.  
• Gestionar cuentas por pagar y por cobrar, manteniendo la información siempre actualizada.  

Valoro especialmente la atención a los detalles, el pensamiento analítico y la iniciativa para proponer mejoras en los procesos. Para completar las tareas cómodamente deberás manejar Excel y las herramientas de Microsoft 365.

Si resides en Latinoamérica será una ventaja por la cercanía de huso horario, aunque estoy abierta a talento de cualquier país mientras cumplas con los requisitos. Indícame tu experiencia específica en QuickBooks Online y casos en que hayas realizado labores similares.

title: Data Cleanup & Web Verification
desc:
For this project I need customer information that is currently scattered across several files merged, de-duplicated, and polished inside one master Excel or Google Sheets workbook. Once the sheet is tidy, every contact detail—name, phone, email, and address—has to be cross-checked against reliable web sources to make sure the data is accurate and up to date.  

When the verification step is done, the final workbook must follow my formatting guidelines (column order, header style, conditional colour coding). I will share a short style guide and a small sample so you can mirror the look and feel exactly.

Deliverables  
• Cleaned and consolidated customer-info spreadsheet  
• Column-by-column log of any corrections made, including URLs or screenshots that confirm each updated contact detail  
• Final file delivered in Excel and Google Sheets formats, formatted to the provided guidelines  

A sharp eye, solid command of Excel formulas and data-validation tools, plus clear, timely communication are must-haves. If that sounds like you, let’s get started right away.

title: Recover Deleted Camera video
desc:
I pulled a 64 GB SanDisk Ultra microSDXC card from my security camera as soon as I realised the clip I need—recordings from 3 August—had disappeared. Roughly 53 GB of the card was filled when I removed it; the camera routinely overwrites anything older than two days, so at present I can still see 7 and 8 August files, and even some fragments from 6 August when I run Restore My Files. Nothing newer has been written since the card came out of the camera, and there have been no error messages during any attempt so far. Other than Restore My Files, no additional recovery tools have touched the card.

What I need now is an experienced data-recovery specialist who has successfully brought back video from microSD cards used in cameras. The goal is simple: retrieve every playable file from 3 August before any latent data is lost for good.

Deliverable  
• Playable video files (original resolution/format) shot on 3 August.

When you reply, please tell me:  
– Your closest comparable recovery jobs and outcomes.  
– Your estimated probability of success for this case.  
– Your fee structure for both the initial examination and the full recovery.  
– How soon you can start and how long the process is likely to take.

The card is ready to be shipped or imaged as you prefer, and I’ll follow any handling instructions you provide to maximise the chances of full recovery.

title: Accurate Scanned Document Typing
desc:
I will supply a series of scanned images that must be re-typed into clean, editable files. The pages include plenty of numbers as well as text, so precision is critical—every figure has to match the source exactly. A steady typing speed of 35–60 wpm is fine as long as accuracy stays high throughout.  

Microsoft Word and, where tables or calculations appear, Microsoft Excel should be used so the final files mirror the original layout and can be searched, edited, and archived easily.  

Deliverables  
• One properly formatted Word or Excel file for each scanned page  
• Correct spelling, punctuation, and—most importantly—error-free numerical data  
• File names that follow the original document order for straightforward cross-checking  

I will review the work by comparing it against the scans; any discrepancies in numbers or omitted content will need correction before final approval.

title: B2B Telesales Lead Generation
desc:
I need an experienced telesales professional who can pick up the phone, speak confidently with businesses in my chosen regions, and turn cold prospects into warm leads for our digital-marketing and affiliate solutions. The single focus is drumming up new business; every call you place should aim to book a discovery meeting or secure a clear next step with a decision-maker.

You will receive:  
• A concise brief on our services (SEO, email marketing, social media management, affiliate sign-ups, and more).  
• A target list of companies, including contact names where available.  
• Access to our cloud CRM for logging outcomes.

What I expect from you:  
• Professional, consultative calling that positions us as a partner, not a pushy salesperson.  
• Daily report of dials, conversations, and scheduled follow-ups.  
• Insightful feedback on objections you encounter so we can fine-tune the pitch.  
• Accurate data entry in the CRM; no loose spreadsheets or missed notes.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. Minimum agreed call volume reached each day.  
2. All call outcomes recorded with next action.  
3. A weekly summary highlighting number of new leads, appointments set, and any trending objections.

If you’re persuasive on the phone, comfortable talking to business owners and marketing managers, and disciplined with CRM notes, let’s talk.

title: Recover 3 Aug & Nearby Recordings
desc:
My security unit overwrites footage after two days, yet I still see traces of 6 August files when I scan the disk (57 GB capacity, 53 GB in use) with “Restore My Files.” This tells me the data from 3 August—and hopefully the neighbouring days—is still lingering in unallocated space.

I need those 3 August recordings brought back and saved directly onto the same device in their original MP4 format. If you can rescue anything just before or after that date as well, even better, but the 3 August material is the priority.

You will have remote or on-site access to the drive image, whichever is safer for data integrity, and I’m happy to create a sector-by-sector clone if you instruct me. Please outline the recovery workflow you intend to follow, the tools you trust (e.g., R-Studio, PhotoRec, GetDataBack, or your own custom scripts), and how you will verify file completeness before handing them over.

Successful delivery means:
• MP4 files from 3 August restored and playable on the device.  
• Any additional footage you can salvage from the surrounding dates placed in a separate folder.  
• A short note on what was recoverable and any sectors that proved unrecoverable.

Let me know your estimated turnaround and any preparatory steps you need from my side.

title: Penulis Konten Facebook Produk
desc:
Saya membutuhkan rangkaian konten tertulis khusus untuk Facebook yang secara konsisten menginformasikan produk dan layanan kami kepada audiens. Fokusnya hanya pada platform Facebook; saya tidak memerlukan materi untuk Instagram atau LinkedIn saat ini.

Ruang lingkup pekerjaan:
• Menyusun kalender konten selama satu bulan (4–5 posting per pekan) yang selaras dengan kampanye pemasaran aktif.  
• Menulis caption menarik, singkat, dan mudah dipahami yang menonjolkan keunggulan produk/layanan serta ajakan bertindak yang jelas.  
• Menyertakan rekomendasi gaya visual (format gambar atau video singkat) agar tim desain dapat menyesuaikan, tanpa perlu membuat desainnya sendiri.  
• Menggunakan nada komunikasi profesional tetapi tetap ramah, sesuai karakter brand kami.  
• Mengoptimalkan teks dengan kata kunci relevan untuk membantu jangkauan organik di Facebook.

Kriteria keberhasilan:
• Setiap posting memuat informasi produk/layanan secara akurat dan tidak berlebihan.  
• Bahasa bebas salah eja, tata bahasa rapi, dan konsisten.  
• Konten siap unggah dalam format .docx atau Google Docs, lengkap dengan jadwal penayangan.  

Berikan contoh singkat satu caption yang pernah Anda tulis untuk produk sejenis agar saya dapat menilai kecocokan gaya penulisan Anda.

4. Responder un pequeño formulario de cinco preguntas por cada llamada y enviarnos las cotizaciones recibidas mediante el mismo formulario (Tiempo aproximado 1 hora).
